header.title: De-Addiction Treatment
header.subtitle: Structured, compassionate support to help you or someone you love break free from substance dependence and rebuild a healthier life.

imageAlt: Two people in a warm, supportive conversation outdoors

overview.title: You are not defined by your addiction
paragraphs: Addiction is a treatable medical and psychological condition, not a moral failing. Our de-addiction program treats the whole person, not just the substance.
We combine medically supervised detoxification with counseling, peer support, and family involvement, so recovery is steady, safe, and sustainable.
Every treatment plan is confidential and built around your specific situation, whether you're seeking help for yourself or supporting someone you love.

items.title: Medical Detoxification
items.description: Safe, supervised withdrawal management in a supportive clinical setting.

items.title: Individual Counseling
items.description: One-on-one sessions to address the root causes behind substance use.

items.title: Group Therapy & Peer Support
items.description: Shared recovery experiences with others who understand the journey.

items.title: Family Counseling
items.description: Rebuilding trust and communication with loved ones affected by addiction.

items.title: Relapse Prevention Planning
items.description: Practical coping strategies and trigger management for long-term sobriety.

items.title: Aftercare & Follow-up
items.description: Ongoing check-ins and support groups after the primary program ends.

whoItsFor.title: Who this program is for

Anyone whose substance use is affecting work, relationships, or health
